text: {"alternatives":[{"component_id":"c4","service":"SQL Database","sku":"4 vCore","details":"General Purpose provisioned, Gen5, 4 vCore, zone redundant, 250 GB, license included","rationale":"Business Critical 8 vCore is likely oversized for ~5,000 users; General Purpose with zone redundancy cuts cost sharply while keeping EU residency and zone-level HA.","tradeoffs":["Higher storage latency than Business Critical (remote storage)","Failover takes longer than BC","Needs a load check that 4 vCore is sufficient at the 9-18 peak"],"also_replaces":[]},{"component_id":"c4","service":"SQL Database","sku":"8 vCore","details":"General Purpose serverless, Gen5, max 8 vCore, min 1 vCore, zone redundant, 250 GB, auto-pause disabled (production)","rationale":"Compute scales down outside the 9:00-18:00 peak and is billed per second, so you pay for 8 vCore only while it is actually busy.","tradeoffs":["Brief latency after rapid scale-up","Cache warm-up after scale-down","Cost depends on real usage pattern"],"also_replaces":[]},{"component_id":"c4","service":"Azure Database for PostgreSQL","sku":"Standard_D4ds_v5","details":"Flexible Server, General Purpose, zone-redundant HA, 4 vCore, 256 GB storage, North Europe","rationale":"Open-source engine has no per-vCore SQL license premium, and a smaller zone-redundant HA setup is much cheaper than Business Critical 8 vCore.","tradeoffs":["Requires migrating schema and code from SQL Server to PostgreSQL","Only viable if the app is not tied to T-SQL features","Migration effort and testing"],"also_replaces":[]},{"component_id":"c2","service":"Azure App Service","sku":"P1v3","details":"Premium v3 P1v3, Linux, 2 instances, with autoscale rule (scale in out of hours)","rationale":"P2v3 is double the size of P1v3; the same instance count at P1v3 halves compute cost if CPU and memory headroom allow, and autoscale can cut it further off-peak.","tradeoffs":["Half the vCPU/RAM per instance (2 vCPU, 8 GB)","Needs a load test at the 9-18 peak","Autoscale adds a little cold-start latency"],"also_replaces":[]},{"component_id":"c2","service":"Azure Container Apps","sku":"Standard","details":"Consumption plan, 2 vCPU 4 GiB per replica, min 2 replicas during business hours, scale on HTTP concurrency, Linux container","rationale":"Pay-per-use vCPU/memory with scaling to the minimum replica count off-peak is cheaper than two always-on P2v3 instances.","tradeoffs":["Requires containerizing the web app and API","Different deployment and ops model","Fewer App Service-specific features such as deployment slots"],"also_replaces":[]},{"component_id":"c3","service":"Functions","sku":"Consumption","details":"Consumption plan Linux, timer trigger nightly, ~20 min run, 1-2 GB memory; Durable Functions or batching if the run exceeds the 10 min default timeout (set functionTimeout up to 10 min, or use a Container Apps job instead)","rationale":"A job running 20 minutes per night does not need an always-ready Premium instance; paying only for execution time costs a few dollars a month.","tradeoffs":["Consumption timeout is max 10 min, so the job must be chunked or made durable","Cold start (acceptable for a nightly job)","No VNet integration on Consumption"],"also_replaces":[]},{"component_id":"c3","service":"Azure Container Apps","sku":"Standard","details":"Container Apps job, Consumption plan, cron trigger nightly, 1 vCPU 2 GiB, ~20 min per run, Linux container","rationale":"A scheduled job has no idle cost and is billed only for the ~20 minutes it runs, with no 10-minute timeout limit.","tradeoffs":["Job code must be packaged as a container","Migration from the Functions programming model","Needs a container registry"],"also_replaces":[]},{"component_id":"c5","service":"Redis Cache","sku":"C1","details":"Standard C1, 1 GB, used for sessions","rationale":"Session storage for ~5,000 users is small, so a C1 (1 GB) Standard cache with replication is enough and costs less than C2.","tradeoffs":["Less memory and bandwidth","Check the session size and peak connection count"],"also_replaces":[]},{"component_id":"c5","service":"Redis Cache","sku":"C0","details":"Basic C0 (250 MB), no replication, used for sessions","rationale":"Smallest and cheapest Redis tier if sessions are tiny and loss of a cache node (users re-login) is acceptable.","tradeoffs":["No SLA or replica, so a node failure drops all sessions","Very limited memory and connections","Not recommended if session loss is unacceptable in production"],"also_replaces":[]},{"component_id":"c6","service":"Storage","sku":"Standard_LRS","details":"Blob, Cool access tier, LRS, ~500 GB invoice PDFs, lifecycle rule to move blobs not read in 30 days to Cool","rationale":"Invoices are written once and rarely read afterwards, so Cool storage lowers the per-GB cost while keeping data in the EU.","tradeoffs":["Higher read and write operation costs","30-day minimum retention charge","Slightly lower availability SLA"],"also_replaces":[]}]}
